newsitem.title: USA: Louisiana Land has two more producing wells.
newsitem.headline: Louisiana Land has two more producing wells.

text.p: Louisiana Land and Exploration Co said Friday that two more exploratory wells, the A-8 and the A-6/sidetrack, have been completed at South Timbalier 148 in the Gulf of Mexico.
The A-8 and A-6/sidetrack wells are now on production, the company said. The field is located 45 miles offshore Louisiana in 110 feet of water, the company said.

Prior to the drilling of these wells, the platform was producing about seven million cubic feet of natural gas and 80 barrels of condensate per day. Total gross platform production has increased to 89 million cubic feet of natural gas per day and 4,100 barrels of condensate per day, it said.
Louisianna Land said it owns a 40.35 percent working interest in the field.
Other working interest owners include Chevron Corp the operator, with a 40 percent interest; Forcenergy Inc with a 15.55 percent interest; and Murphy Oil Corp with a three percent interest.
